sources.supports: getRunsPage and getAllRuns validate the project ID and place it as the only path segment. createdAfter, createdBefore and refs are forwarded unchanged; createdBy, milestoneId and suiteId go through serializeIdFilter; includePlanRuns and isCompleted are converted from booleans to 1 or 0. The query is built in that fixed order ahead of the paging controls, and the envelope collection is named runs. The deprecated refsFilter option, which would send refs and refs_filter together for servers before TestRail 10.4, is not surfaced by this tool.
serializeIdFilter validates one identifier or each member of an array with validateId and joins an array with commas; serializeIdList joins a list without validating it and omits an empty one.

The page helper validates limit and offset before dispatch and appends them after the filters. The all helper copies only pageSize, startOffset, maxPages, maxItems, maxDurationMs and maxBytes from its options.

collectAllPages validates every bound before the first request, defaults pageSize to 250 and startOffset to 0, requires the first envelope offset to equal startOffset, and stops when _links.next is null.
buildEndpoint appends controls path-style after an ampersand, skips undefined values and percent-encodes every key and value independently.

get_runs/{project_id} returns the runs of a project that are not part of a test plan, and points readers at get_plans for those. Its filters are created_after and created_before as UNIX timestamps, created_by as a comma-separated user-ID list, include_plan_runs and is_completed as 0 or 1, milestone_id and suite_id as comma-separated ID lists, refs as a single reference, and limit and offset. It returns up to 250 entries inside an offset, limit, size and _links envelope. The fields, status_id, label_id, priority_id, assignedto_id and updated_by filters require TestRail 10.8 and are outside the pinned driver.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement at every depth. TestRail documents every creator filter as a comma-separated list, but the driver's option for created_by is an array alone, so this tool takes an array there and a single ID or an array for the two filters whose option accepts both. Filters the pinned driver does not carry are rejected as unknown query keys rather than dropped.

outer_result.notes: Page mode returns the driver's decoded page and all mode the collected array. Runs belonging to a test plan appear only when include_plan_runs asks for them; reading a plan is the other way to reach them. Entity-field drift is advisory.

parameters.semantics: Creators to match, as user IDs. The driver's option for this filter is an array rather than the scalar-or-array its neighbours accept, so this tool takes an array and sends it comma-joined; an empty one would drop the filter and is refused.

wire.encoding: Decimal integers joined by commas, percent-encoded as %2C, appended path-style before the paging controls.

Accept a list of user IDs and send them comma-joined.
Reject a non-positive member before driver invocation.

Send no control when the caller did not supply one.

parameters.semantics: Whether runs belonging to a test plan are listed as well as standalone ones. Taken as a boolean here and converted by the driver to the 1 or 0 TestRail reads; omitting it sends no control, which is not the same as sending either value.

wire.encoding: include_plan_runs=1 for true and include_plan_runs=0 for false, appended path-style before the paging controls.

requirements.description: Preserve the value as the includePlanRuns option.
Accept true and send include_plan_runs=1, listing plan runs too.
Accept false and send include_plan_runs=0, listing standalone runs only.
Reject a numeric stand-in for the boolean before driver invocation.
Send no control when the caller did not supply one.

parameters.semantics: Whether completed or active runs are listed. Taken as a boolean here and converted by the driver to the 1 or 0 TestRail reads; omitting it sends no control, which is not the same as sending either value.

wire.encoding: is_completed=1 for true and is_completed=0 for false, appended path-style before the paging controls.

requirements.description: Preserve the value as the isCompleted option.
Accept true and send is_completed=1, listing completed runs.
Accept false and send is_completed=0, listing active runs only.
Reject a numeric stand-in for the boolean before driver invocation.
Send no control when the caller did not supply one.
